title: Clinical Intervention Evidence Synthesis
description: Structured guideline-vs-trial evidence review for therapeutic efficacy & safety.
executive_summary_intent: Synthesize consensus guidelines, randomized trial efficacy outcomes, contraindications, and residual uncertainty across provided literature.

sections.section_title: I. Guideline Standard of Care & Diagnostic Criteria
sections.stated_intention: Establish baseline society/government guideline recommendations and patient eligibility.
sections.routing_rationale: Anchor recommendations in authoritative clinical guidelines `(b)`.
required_fact_queries: Target patient population, baseline severity, and exclusion criteria in provided packet

sections.section_title: II. Comparative Efficacy From Trials & Observational Studies
sections.stated_intention: Quantify effect sizes, confidence intervals, and endpoints across primary studies.
sections.routing_rationale: Extract quantitative primary endpoints and distinguish RCTs from observational cohorts.
required_fact_queries: Primary clinical trial sample sizes, endpoints, and hazard/odds ratios
Observational cohort outcomes and confounding adjustments

sections.section_title: III. Safety Profile, Contraindications & Evidence Gaps
sections.stated_intention: Document adverse event rates, conflicting trial results, and methodological limitations.
sections.routing_rationale: Surface safety trade-offs and open trial/guideline discrepancies honestly.
required_fact_queries: Reported severe adverse events, discontinuation rates, and contraindications
